attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moving LastTaskId into the Entity's persisted metadata bag (from a private field) changes on-disk settings shape and will reset existing indexes' task tracking to 0 causing a full reindex, and the index-name uniqueness check now ignores Source which could unexpectedly block updates for tenants with same-named indexes across different sources."}

reason: Moving LastTaskId into the Entity's persisted metadata bag (from a private field) changes on-disk settings shape and will reset existing indexes' task tracking to 0 causing a full reindex, and the index-name uniqueness check now ignores Source which could unexpectedly block updates for tenants with same-named indexes across different sources.
